quests.hint: 'label' stresses LA, 'clearly' has [kl] and [rl], 'fragile' stresses FRA, and 'bottom' has a [t] that is often a tap.
quests.explanation: A reminder list: a rise after each item and a fall on 'door'. Keep 'Don't forget to' quick and friendly.
quests.textToSpeak: Don't forget to label each box clearly, stack the heavy ones at the bottom, and keep anything fragile away from the door.
quests.phoneticHint: [ˈdoʊnt fərˈget tə ˈleɪbəl ˈiːtʃ ˈbɒks ˈklɪrli] | [ˈstæk ðə ˈhevi wʌnz ət ðə ˈbɒtəm] | [ənd ˈkiːp ˈeniθɪŋ ˈfrædʒaɪl əˈweɪ frəm ðə ˈdɔːr].
